verdict.rationale: Datalab offers building blocks you could use for bulk processing: a CLI for command-line conversion, reusable versioned pipelines, async webhooks that avoid polling, file storage reused across API calls, and Team-plan rate limits of 400 req/min. None of the evidence documents an explicit batch or bulk operation that acts on many documents at once, so bulk work appears to require client-side orchestration. Missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk endpoint or CLI directory/multi-file mode, bulk status/management of many jobs, and hands-on corroboration of high-volume batch runs.
